description: Get one task’s cost: the amount charged once Wiro has billed it, with the model's list price beside it when a discount made them differ. Successful tasks are billed; failed tasks and tasks cancelled while queued are not, and a task stopped while running can still be charged once its work ends. A finished task's result already shows its cost, so use this for a task whose result you do not have, or whose result shows only the list price. If the task is active, follow the returned `wait_for_task` next action.

tasktoken.description: The task token returned from run_model.

name: get_task_price

costUsd.description: The amount charged so far; null while the task is active or a successful task's charge is not recorded yet. While billed is null, a later charge is still possible.

chargedUsd.description: What the payer was charged, after any discount.

costUsd.description: The model's list price for this task.

title: Get a Wiro task price
